description: Bayt.com job search for the Middle East and North Africa: job id, title, company, location, summary, posted time (date and Bayt's label), Easy Apply flag, company logo and job link for a keyword in a country (optionally a city), up to ~30 jobs per page. From bayt.com via a residential proxy. Price: $0.01 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

city.description: Optional city slug, e.g. dubai, abu-dhabi, riyadh

country.description: Bayt country slug: uae, saudi-arabia, qatar, kuwait, oman, bahrain, egypt, jordan, lebanon, morocco, ... (default uae)

query.description: Job keyword, e.g. python, accountant, nurse

name: jobs_bayt
